modalities.title: Modalities
modalities.help: Each distance has its kits and its prices per price tier.
modalities.emptyMessage: An event needs at least one active modality, with a kit and a price, before it can be published.
modalities.warningNoKit: At least one active kit is missing.
modalities.cannotPublish: The event cannot be published like this.
modalities.noItemsYet: No items have been loaded yet. Add them from Settings.
modalities.includedItemsHelp: If the kit includes an item that requires a size (such as "Official shirt"), the size becomes mandatory on the public form. If the kit already has registrations without a size, the API rejects the change and asks for the sizes first. Items are managed from Settings.
modalities.priceOverlapHelp: Price tiers cannot overlap: with two valid prices at once it would not be predictable which one is charged.
